overview.description: The Tema U.S. Manufacturing & Reshoring ETF (WELD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in industrials equity. The fund actively manages a narrow portfolio of US stocks that are anticipated to benefit from deglobalization. The funds adviser combines a top-down and bottom-up approach to selecting and weighting fund holdings. WELD was launched on May 10, 2023 and is issued by Tema.
